name: 2-Player Coin Pusher with Ticket Payout
headline: High-attraction two-player coin pusher that pays out tickets
description: A twin-lane coin pusher with moving shelves, LED light shows and ticket payout at winning levels. Coins cascade for a highly addictive experience that keeps players feeding credits. This is a sample placeholder product - full spec subject to change.

Multi-layer LED cabinet lighting and attract mode

Operator menu: coin value, win %, sound & light settings
